title_en: Spreadsheets, applied steps and dirty data
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: الداتا الحقيقية بايظة، وإنك تعرف بايظة إزاي بالظبط دي مهارة.
sentences.en: Real data is broken, and knowing exactly how it is broken is a skill.

sentences.ar: خمستاشر صف وتمن عيوب حقيقية: صف مكرر، وأسماء فيها مسافات زيادة وحالة أحرف مش ثابتة،
sentences.en: Fifteen rows, eight genuine defects: a duplicated row, names with stray spaces and inconsistent case,

sentences.ar: وصيغ تواريخ مخلوطة، وحالة أحرف مخلوطة في الـchannel، وفاصلة مستخدمة كعلامة عشرية، ومسافة مستخدمة كفاصل آلاف، وكمية فاضية، واسم عميل فاضي.
sentences.en: mixed date formats, mixed channel casing, a comma used as a decimal point, a space used as a thousands separator, a blank quantity, and a blank customer name.

sentences.ar: حداشر طريقة كتابة بيبقوا سبعة لما الـtrim يشتغل، وبيبقوا خمس عملاء حقيقيين لما الـproper case يشتغل وواحد اسمه فاضي ما يتحلّش غير بالـcustomer key.
sentences.en: Eleven different spellings collapse to seven when trim runs, and to five real customers when proper-case runs — plus one blank name that only the customer key can resolve.

sentences.ar: وفي مشكلتين كمان بيعيشوا بعد ده كله، لأنهم مش مشاكل تنسيق أصلاً.
sentences.en: And two more problems survive all of this, because they are not formatting problems at all.
We will meet them at the quality gate.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي الفكرة اللي ورا Power Query، وورا dbt، وورا أي pipeline tool هتستخدمه في حياتك: سجّل الـخطوات، مش النتيجة.
sentences.en: Now the idea behind Power Query, behind dbt, behind every pipeline tool you will ever use: record the steps, not the result.

sentences.ar: لستة خطوات مسجلة تقدر تشغّلها على ملف الشهر الجاي؛ النسخة المنضّفة لأ.
sentences.en: A recorded step list can be replayed on next month's file; a cleaned copy cannot.

sentences.ar: وأهو الجزء اللي المفروض يخوّفك شوية.
sentences.en: And here is the part that should frighten you slightly.

sentences.ar: غيّر ترتيب خطوتين والإجمالي يتحول من تلاتة وتسعميّة وتمنية وأربعين ونص لأربعة ألاف وميّة وسبعة وسبعين ومن غير ما يطلع أي error خالص.
sentences.en: Reorder two steps and the total changes from three thousand nine hundred and forty-eight fifty to four thousand one hundred and seventy-seven — and no error is raised at all.
The pipeline is green. The number is wrong.

sentences.ar: ودي الـfailure المميزة لأدوات التحويل: مش crash، لكن إجابة واثقة اتنتجت بترتيب غير الترتيب اللي إنت وثّقته.
sentences.en: That is the characteristic failure of transformation tools: not a crash, but a confident answer produced by a different sequence than the one you documented.

sentences.ar: واعتبر الكمية الفاضية صفر بدل ما تستبعد الصف، هتطلع برقم تالت.
sentences.en: Treat the blank quantity as zero instead of excluding the row and you get a third number.

sentences.ar: خمسة وتسعين يورو هي بالظبط قيمة قرار السياسة الواحد ده.
sentences.en: Ninety-five euros is exactly what that one policy decision is worth.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A data table (<= 8 columns, <= 12 visible rows); numbers come from a data_ref.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
